SIM_BODY: As BL-021 / BL-024: the sim's 1 g frame-side forces scaled by g x load / 68 kg, closed on the payload weight at the sim CG (force -> 4 under-strap pins, sagittal moment -> hook / hinge couple).
T9 loaded CG + frame strain gauges at the stays, the mid bar and the lumbar struts in the T1 carry test.
FLOOR_SPAN: The hinge-pin lateral pull (the bag floor spanning pin to pin like a hammock, 62-208 N a side at 1 g in the meat case over every converged CORRIE F run) is taken as real: the sim pins the bag at both hinge nodes, and the real bag floor is cut to the same width.
T2 meat test: a load pin (or strain-gauged hinge pin) at one stay foot, lateral component, 23 in torso, 68 kg meat.
EULER_RULE: Team A's Euler rule unchanged (frame_comp_A.member_buckling: pinned-pinned K 1, the member's voxel area at the cut as a solid round section, E_xy x 0.6 hot x 0.7 creep, margin = P_cr / (1.5 x factored compression)). Stays and the mid-bar junctions give some end fixity, so K 1 is conservative.
Optional: a linear eigenvalue (buckling) run of the voxel body under the governing set, or a printed-frame side-squeeze test (T1 rig, 2 x 1.5 x the factored load at the stay feet).
CINCH_STATIC: As BL-021 / BL-024: the meat-strap cinch is a static preload (fatigue on the static-carry set without the cinch loop).
MT-1 strap tension readout over a 10 min loaded walk.
MESH: 2 mm voxel grid (the FI99 rule, KEEP 1.02 and the cut areas are calibrated on it); a member area is a whole number of 4 mm2 voxel faces, so growth is judged on the cut area actually rastered.
Slicer cross-section of the printed mid bar / upper branches against the rastered areas.

governing_region.peak_region: stay L lower sleeve z 160-240 (branch / strut root)
